title: Conveyancing Assistant
description:
Conveyancing Assistant

Salary: Competitive, dependent on experience
Location: Norwich, Norfolk

SJC Legal is currently working with a well-established and highly regarded law firm looking to recruit an experienced Conveyancing Assistant to join its Residential Property team in Norwich.

This is an excellent opportunity for a Legal Assistant or Paralegal with residential conveyancing experience who is looking to join a reputable firm and provide valuable support to experienced Conveyancers within a busy property department.

The Benefits
- Competitive salary depending on experience
- Opportunity to join an established Residential Property team
- Work alongside experienced Conveyancers and Solicitors
- Exposure to a varied residential conveyancing caseload
- Opportunity to further develop your conveyancing knowledge and experience

The Role
- Provide day-to-day support to Residential Conveyancing Fee Earners
- Assist with Freehold and Leasehold Sales and Purchases
- Support transactions from initial instruction through to completion and post-completion
- Prepare conveyancing documentation and correspondence
- Order property searches and assist with enquiries
- Liaise with clients, estate agents, mortgage brokers and other solicitors
- Assist with exchange and completion processes
- Maintain accurate records using the firm's Case Management system
- Ensure matters progress efficiently while delivering excellent client care

The Candidate
- Have previous experience within Residential Conveyancing
- Be an experienced Conveyancing Assistant, Legal Assistant or Property Paralegal
- Have a good understanding of the residential conveyancing process
- Be confident communicating with clients and other professionals
- Have strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail
- Be comfortable managing competing priorities and deadlines
- Be proactive, reliable and able to work effectively as part of a team

How to Apply
For a confidential discussion regarding this opportunity, or to discuss other conveyancing positions currently available across Norfolk, please contact Alex Wilcock, Legal Recruitment Consultant at SJC Legal.

title: Conveyancing Assistant
description:
We are delighted to be working in partnership with a well-established legal firm who are looking to recruit an experienced Conveyancing Assistant to join their friendly and supportive team based in Norwich on a part time basis.

This is an excellent opportunity to join a busy conveyancing department, providing administrative support to the New Build Conveyancing team and assisting with the smooth day-to-day running of files and transactions.

Key Responsibilities:
- Providing administrative support to the residential conveyancing team, including file management and handling correspondence.
- Liaising professionally with clients, conveyancers, solicitors and third parties.
- Updating and maintaining the case management system, ensuring records are accurate and up to date.
- Responding to queries and delivering a high standard of client service.
- Supporting the team with general administrative duties as required.

Previous Skills & Experience:
- Previous experience within conveyancing or a legal support role would be advantageous, although not essential.
- Strong administration and organisational skills, with excellent attention to detail.
- Confident communication skills, both written and verbal.
- Able to work effectively under pressure and manage competing priorities.
- A proactive and flexible approach, with the ability to work well as part of a team.

What's on Offer?
- The opportunity to join a friendly and supportive legal team.
- A collaborative working environment.
- Competitive salary and benefits package.

If you have strong administration skills and are interested in developing your career within residential conveyancing, we would love to hear from you.

Apply today to find out more!

title: Legal Secretary
company: Infinity Recruitment Consultancy Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Our superb client with offices based in King's Lynn is seeking an experienced Legal Secretary to join the on a full time permanent basis working 8.45am - 5.00pm Monday to Friday.

As Legal Secretary, you will be responsible for typing of documents using digital dictation, setting up new case files, dealing with queries, taking messages, arranging appointments, scanning, filing, photocopying and support administration.

To be considered for the role of Legal Secretary, you will have previous and recent legal secretarial experience, in a fast paced and busy environment, you will have excellent written and verbal communication skills, fast and accurate typing speeds and will be PC literate.

In return, for the role of Legal Secretary, our client is offering a starting salary of c 28,000, flexible holiday entitlement, pension, social events, ongoing training and development.

Send your CV now for consideration.

title: Legal Secretary
description:
Legal Secretary - Litigation

Dereham, Norfolk

Competitive Salary (DOE)

Full-Time Permanent

Our client, a well-established and highly respected law firm based in Dereham, is seeking an experienced Legal Secretary to join their busy and successful Litigation Department.

This is an excellent opportunity for a professional and organised individual who thrives in a fast-paced legal environment and enjoys providing high-quality support to solicitors and fee earners.

Key Responsibilities
- Providing secretarial and administrative support to the Litigation team
- Audio and copy typing of legal correspondence and documents
- Preparing court bundles and legal documentation
- Managing diaries, appointments, and meeting arrangements
- Handling incoming calls and client enquiries professionally
- Opening, closing, and maintaining client files
- Liaising with clients, courts, barristers, and third parties
- Assisting with billing, file management, and document production
- Ensuring compliance with legal and regulatory procedures

About You
- Previous experience as a Legal Secretary is essential
- Experience within Litigation would be highly advantageous
- Excellent typing and IT skills, including Microsoft Office
- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail
- Professional communication skills, both written and verbal
- Ability to manage a varied workload and meet deadlines
- Friendly, proactive, and team-oriented approach

What's on Offer?
- Competitive salary dependent on experience
- Friendly and supportive working environment
- Opportunity to work for a reputable local law firm
- Long-term career development opportunities
- Generous holiday entitlement and additional benefits

If you are an experienced Legal Secretary looking to join a welcoming and professional firm in Dereham, we would love to hear from you.

title: Legal Secretary (Conveyancing)
description:
Legal Secretary (Conveyancing)

- Ability to prioritise their own workload
- Strong attention to detail, communication and interpersonal skills

title: paralegal
description:
Job Title: Paralegal

About the Role

We are seeking a motivated, organised and detail-oriented Paralegal to join a legal team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with previous legal experience who is looking to develop their skills and progress their career within a professional legal environment.

The successful candidate will provide legal and administrative support to solicitors and fee earners, assisting with case management, legal documentation, client communication and the day-to-day running of legal matters.

Key Responsibilities
- Assisting solicitors and fee earners with the management and progression of legal cases.
- Preparing, drafting and reviewing legal documents and correspondence.
- Conducting legal research and summarising findings where required.
- Maintaining accurate and up-to-date client files and case management records.
- Liaising with clients, courts, counsel, third parties and other relevant organisations.
- Preparing bundles, schedules and supporting documentation.
- Monitoring deadlines and ensuring documents are completed and submitted on time.
- Supporting case preparation and ensuring compliance with relevant procedures.
- Providing general administrative support to the legal team.
- Maintaining confidentiality and delivering a professional standard of client care.

Requirements
- Previous experience working within a legal environment is desirable, with experience requirements depending on the level of the role.
- A law degree, LPC, SQE-related qualification or relevant legal experience would be advantageous.
- Good written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail.
- The ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
- A professional and client-focused approach.
- The ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Good IT skills and familiarity with legal case management systems would be beneficial.

The Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate will be proactive, reliable and enthusiastic about developing their legal career. They will have a strong work ethic, a willingness to learn and the ability to support a busy legal team effectively.

How to Apply

If you have the relevant skills and experience and are interested in developing your career within the legal sector, we would welcome your application.
